c74object.name: evi_curve
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Reimplementation of MSP curve~ in gen abstraction form
c74object.description:
evi_curve is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_curve is almost identical to MSP curve~ (without list processing of course) providing exact ramp destination time and curve parameter. In gen~ this is expensive and therefore not so useful. Based on Graham Wakefield's original example (which is no longer present in the gen~ examples folder).

geninlet.name: destination
geninlet.digest: Value. Input value to be ramped.

geninlet.name: ramp
geninlet.digest: Time in SAMPLES. Amount of time the value takes to reach it's destination. evi_curve reaches it's destination exactly in this time.

geninlet.name: curve
geninlet.digest: -1..1 @min -1 @max 1. Exponential curvature of the ramp. In evi_curve (as opposed to MSP curve~) this value never becomes very sharp at the extremes of this setting, but retains a small amount of curvature, due to the approximations used in the calculations.
